author: Cuvier, 1831

note.en: A small open-water pomfret recorded for the Caribbean and listed by FishBase for Costa Rica, but with no local sighting; people here are not likely to meet it.
note.es: Una pequeña japuta de aguas abiertas registrada para el Caribe y citada por FishBase para Costa Rica, pero sin avistamientos locales; es poco probable que la gente de aquí la encuentre.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
recWhy: No record on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast in the file (general range or Costa Rica only).
